payload.claim: `source_mutated` is also wired as the `mutate` callable for vacuity-probe scoring (`docs/evidence/scripts/2026-09-08-lens-corpus.py:244`), a path this spec's scope never mentions and pytest never exercises against the real function (it is mocked in `tests/test_probe_check.py` and `tests/test_corpus.py`).
